text:
- [RARC.5.8.8] **`event_id` is a deterministic derivation.** The UUID is
  keyed on the run identifier, the tier identifier and the `seq` of the fact's
  `FactAssert` ([LFST.5.6]), by the function [RFCS.6.8] states, so
  distinct keys derive distinct `event_id`s. All three inputs reproduce on
  replay; reading `/dev/urandom` would break replay ([LDET.6.4.2]). The
  `event_id` identifies a fact within this engine only: a fact received from
  another tier gets this engine's own ([LFST.5.6]).

alloy.name: rarc_5_8_8__same_key_same_id
alloy.note: Two events with one key carry one event_id, which is what makes replay reproduce it. Rests on the stamp rule and on the key being the whole input to the derivation jointly; a hidden input such as a clock or /dev/urandom is what fails it.
